seat:generative-and-continuation.answer_in_one_paragraph: AI-written (Fable). "Keeps remaking what it rests on" has no Lean object; three families hold pieces. The grammar has renewal without end and generate/keep/degenerate, with no stock. The World family has renewing and consuming as whole-run classes, exclusive, not exhaustive, no boundary; its laws are one-step keeping, needs of going on, and endings. Exact boundaries exist only where giving is a function of what is left: RegimeMargin (one condition, and a web under mutual support) and the November line, whose iffs conclude 不穷 under 一, where the grammar proves no 生生. In the line, units only take; the stock remakes itself. The join was a dictionary because Flow's give is free, so under balance a premise is its conclusion; October's RenewalFlow built the same instance for a gated level law, and the study never names it. Joins that are not one: below both (Amounts, found in round 9), or a level law made a case of the regime.

seat:meta-attractor.answer_in_one_paragraph: Not one object. No declaration in Becoming bears the name; the account reads as one the share-and-rule loop (RuleCapture's family), the lock on a stock (TurningInTime) and selection by persistence (ReadingsPersist). seat:one-state-space.answer_in_one_paragraph: The smallest space is already here twice, unjoined: one level and two needs. RelationalRenewal.Law has a giver that renews only while the level meets its need, and a taker; WayOfUnits.two_units_iff has two takers on a stock that gives by what is left. Read regions on both ends, the way and the level: kept and going on; run down and going on (a taker needing nothing); run down and ended; one dropped, the rest kept. The boundary is the level against take + y(take), rising with the take (rises_by_draw), absent above the greatest giving (ends_beyond_giving). A fixed take never crosses it; a rising take crosses down with no difference yet; a falling take crosses back only where the level after the turn is on its side. The centre cannot say the second region: its laws assume every unit needs something, and its 'never ends' is true of a taker needing nothing (my script, not Lean). Fix beforehand: a given premise becomes a conclusion; changing the stock alone, and the way alone, each flips the conclusion; a named proof older than 12 November returns as a case; the right side is a condition on the start. 'Holds with the stock removed' cannot test a law about a locked course: it holds there by definition.
